blocks.text: Multi-hyphenate artist Nadine Lustre has dropped the official teaser for the music video of her latest single, “Donuts,” featuring global hip-hop superstar Apl.de.Ap of the Black Eyed Peas. The nearly 30-second clip offers a first look at an expansive visual world, introducing Lustre as a warrior princess. With creative direction by Lustre herself, the music video reimagines pre-colonial Philippine royalty through a post-apocalyptic lens, creating a world where tradition and futurism collide.
